relationships.history: He testified in her Cook County courtroom once, against his own partner. She hasn't told him she remembers.
Common Ground takes her community-service placements. Maya argues every one of them up to the bench, and is usually right.
In the public benches every week with a notebook. Evelyn approves, and won't say so.
Whitaker Capital offered to pay for the courtroom's benches. She sent the letter back unopened.

memories.info: Sworn in as Livéra's first judge, in a courtroom with no benches yet.
Heard Marcus Bell testify against his own partner in her Cook County courtroom.

profile.tagline: Thirty years of other people's worst days, and she still listens to every one.

appearance.eyes: dark brown, steady, behind tortoiseshell reading glasses
appearance.face: fine lines at the eyes, a calm mouth, a small scar through the left eyebrow
appearance.style: on the bench: a black judicial robe over a white collared blouse, charcoal trousers, low black pumps; off the bench: a camel cardigan and dark jeans

outfits.everyday: a camel cardigan over a cream blouse, dark straight jeans, white canvas sneakers, the jade bangle
outfits.work: a black judicial robe over a white collared blouse, charcoal wool trousers, low black pumps, tortoiseshell reading glasses on a beaded cord
outfits.evening: a navy silk wrap dress under a grey wool coat, low black heels, small pearl earrings, the jade bangle

appearance.jewelry: a jade bangle from her mother, small pearl studs, reading glasses on a beaded cord
appearance.silhouette: a small upright woman in black who takes up the whole room
key_features: Tortoiseshell reading glasses on a cord

profile.family_background: Born in Philadelphia, the daughter of a Korean grocer and a church organist. Her wife, Ruth, stays in Chicago until the house sells; they talk every night at nine.
profile.education: B.A. History, Temple University; J.D., University of Pennsylvania Law School
goals: Clear the docket every sitting day
ambitions: A court nobody is afraid to walk into
profile.social_preferences: A quiet table, one glass of wine, and nobody who has a case before her.

secrets.truth: Years ago she let a man walk on a technicality she knew was wrong, and he hurt someone a month later. She hasn't ruled on a technicality since.

social_media.bio: Livéra Municipal Court. Hearings are public, Monday to Saturday, nine to five.

life_history: Eleven years as a public defender in Philadelphia.
Fourteen years on the Cook County circuit bench.
Came to Livéra to build a court from an empty room.
